ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70% high-intensity (white/off-white) to 30% low-intensity (black/dark-grey) pixel distribution across the visible surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity white regions occupy the primary area of both lobes. A central, low-intensity dark region extends from the peduncle connection to the median notch. Low-intensity black borders are present along the entire trailing edge and fluke tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped central depression with a calculated vertex angle of approximately 65 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge boundary; prominent peaks and valleys are most acute on the distal halves of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: General convex curvature of the trailing edges tapering to pointed, slightly recurved tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of approximately 6-8 circular, light-grey ring-shaped clusters (rosettes) localized within the low-intensity central dark pigmentation.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Presence of multiple dark, roughly parallel linear pixel streaks (rake marks) on the mid-to-distal section of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable circular scarring patterns (barnacle attachment sites) in the center and distinct linear rake marks on the right fluke lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Small, isolated low-intensity punctate spots (mottling) scattered across the high-intensity white regions of the right lobe.
